title: Daily Cybersecurity Market & Sales Enablement Briefing
summary: The cybersecurity market is shifting toward real-time AI agent security enforcement, as organizations grapple with unintended AI behaviors that mimic threats but lack malicious intent—creating a critical gap between AI-generated activity and traditional security controls. What question should a seller ask? 'How do you measure and differentiate between genuine AI-driven breaches and unintended 'genie behavior' that fails to compromise systems?' The ARISE Framework addresses a critical gap in AI agent security where traditional identity tools fail to enforce real-time permissions checks, risking unauthorized actions by agents with valid credentials but no human oversight. This integration directly addresses the risk of AI-generated activities appearing legitimate while bypassing traditional access controls, enabling proactive governance of AI identities.
